purpose: Freeze the evidence identities, answer-key unlock gate, and deterministic target-scoring rules before the answer key is opened.

required_checks: answer key identity and byte count match without parsing content
Route A archive and audit identities match
Route B archive and audit identities match
Route C-exact archive and audit identities match
Route A raw output remains explicitly contract-incompatible for ranking
Route B remains separated by model source

scoring_units.Route_A: one unranked product-set result per case
scoring_units.Route_B: one independently scored model-source result per case; no pooled Route-B ranking
scoring_units.Route_C_exact: one numerically ordered directed-Rhea result per case

diagnostic_product_scoring.target_definition: Use only diagnostic target product SMILES present in the sealed answer key.
diagnostic_product_scoring.strict_candidate_match: A target is recovered only when its canonical isomeric SMILES exactly equals a canonical molecule component on the prediction product side.

Route_A.candidate_construction: For each case, canonicalize every nonempty vendor CSV product SMILES row, deduplicate canonical products, and test the complete frozen set.
prohibited: using CSV row order as rank
using Reaction ID order as rank
using 0.5 threshold or occurrence ratio as confidence

Route_B.candidate_construction: Use each model source's frozen case-local rank exactly as returned.

Route_C_exact.candidate_construction: Use the frozen numeric directed Rhea ID ascending order.

direction_scoring.definition: Direction passes only when the frozen input substrate is on the left and an answer-key diagnostic product is on the right.
direction_scoring.nitrobenzene_rule: RP-P06 is evaluated only in the RHEA:52886 degradation direction; reverse-direction recovery is direction_fail.
direction_scoring.case_denominator: six valid cases per independently scored route or model source
direction_scoring.Route_A_limitation: Only product-side diagnostic recovery can be reported; complete biochemical direction is NOT_SCOREABLE because no full reaction was emitted.
direction_scoring.Route_B_limitation: Product-side direction recovery is scoreable, but complete biochemical direction is not.
direction_scoring.Route_C_exact: Both product-side direction and complete directed-reaction equivalence are scoreable.

full_reaction_scoring.strict_equivalence: Canonicalize every molecule component on each side with stereochemistry and charge retained; compare side-specific sorted multisets including duplicate multiplicity.
full_reaction_scoring.answer_rhea_id_equivalence: A predicted directed Rhea ID may also count as an identifier-level full-reaction hit only when it equals an accepted directed Rhea ID from the answer key; master-ID-only or reverse-direction equality does not override direction.

rhea_ec_and_candidate_pool_scoring.direct_rhea_recovery: Score only an emitted directed Rhea identifier that matches an answer-key accepted directed Rhea identifier.
rhea_ec_and_candidate_pool_scoring.ec_recovery: Map the recovered directed Rhea identifier to its Rhea master ID and then through frozen rhea2ec.tsv; compare with non-null answer-key EC values. Preserve and report EC-null honestly.
rhea_ec_and_candidate_pool_scoring.candidate_pool_recoverability: For a correctly recovered directed Rhea identifier, map its master ID to the union of frozen Swiss-Prot and TrEMBL UIDs, intersect with complete_d4_enzyme_assets=True, and report whether the resulting pool is nonempty plus its size.
rhea_ec_and_candidate_pool_scoring.candidate_pool_semantics: A nonempty pool means the reaction can technically enter the frozen D4-valid EnzymeCAGE ranking domain; it does not mean a correct enzyme is present or ranked first.
rhea_ec_and_candidate_pool_scoring.untied_technical_pool: Separately report whether any emitted Rhea candidate has a nonempty D4-valid pool, but never count this as target recovery.

invalid_input_safety.pass_condition: RP-N01 yields no prediction and is rejected as invalid input.
invalid_input_safety.denominator: one invalid case per route or model source

reporting_rules.answer_key_schema_adaptation: Only field-name parsing needed to implement these frozen semantics is allowed; semantic rules may not change.

required_adversarial_tests: mutated rank changes or invalid rank are rejected
reversed direction does not score as directed recovery
product-only output cannot score as full-reaction match
